title: Jailbreak Connectivity: Towards Diverse, Transferable, and Universal Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreak
abstract: arXiv:2610.38091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to visual jailbreak attacks that bypass safety safeguards. Existing methods typically optimize isolated adversarial examples, limiting attack diversity, transferability, and generalization. We propose Jailbreak Connectivity (JC), a framework based on the observation that effective adversarial inputs can be connected through low-loss regions in image space. JC optimizes continuous adversarial paths: path sampling yields diverse jailbreak images, lightweight surrogate classifiers guide cross-model transfer, and a distribution-level objective enables universal attacks across harmful queries. On MM-SafetyBench, JC achieves average attack success rates of 84.01%, 85.77%, and 97.95% on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B-IT, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by up to 68.36 percentage points. translated_title: 越狱连通性：迈向多样化、可迁移与通用的多模态大语言模型越狱攻击
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）容易受到能够绕过安全防护机制的视觉越狱攻击。现有方法通常优化孤立的对抗样本，限制了攻击的多样性、可迁移性和泛化能力。我们提出了越狱连通性，这是一个基于以下观察的框架：有效的对抗输入可以通过图像空间中的低损失区域连接起来。JC优化连续的对抗路径：路径采样产生多样化的越狱图像，轻量级代理分类器引导跨模型迁移，分布级目标函数实现对有害查询的通用攻击。在MM-SafetyBench上，JC在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、InternVL3.5-8B和Gemma-3-12B-IT上分别实现了84.01%、85.77%和97.95%的平均攻击成功率，超过最强基线最多68.36个百分点。在黑盒评估中，JC的攻击成功率显著提升……
tldr: 提出越狱连通性框架，通过在图像空间低损失区域优化连续对抗路径，实现多样化、可迁移且通用的多模态大语言模型越狱攻击，攻击成功率显著超越现有最强基线。
en_tdlr: Proposes Jailbreak Connectivity (JC), a framework that optimizes continuous adversarial paths through low-loss regions in image space to achieve diverse, transferable, and universal multimodal LLM jailbreak attacks, significantly outperforming the strongest baselines.
